items.title: 5 Dividend Stocks That Have Raised Payouts for Decades. Are They Still Buys?
items.summary: A decades-long raise streak can hide a thin cushion underneath. Five dividend veterans face the same test: does today's cash flow fund tomorrow's raise? One name on the list pays out nearly every free cash dollar, and another may be priced too high.

items.title: National Fuel Gas Has Paid a Dividend for 124 Straight Years. Can It Keep Going?
items.summary: National Fuel is preparing to break into two companies, and management has not said a word about what happens to the payout afterward. Income investors face a quiet risk that could keep the record alive while shrinking the check.

items.title: The Senate Voted 73-25 to Start Debate on a Bill Making Data Centers Pay Their Own Power Bills
items.summary: A bipartisan energy bill promises to shield households from AI's appetite for electricity, yet a wind dispute, a Title III fight, and a skeptical House could still sink it. Which utility investments stand to gain if it survives?
